# Neutral preparation argument fixtures

These declarations exercise native argv expansion, source-relative paths,
phase output separation, exact template bindings and measurement-only selection.
They are command compilation fixtures, not an executable corpus recipe: input
releases, family inventories, source bytes and release declarations are deliberately
absent. Tests render tiny YAML declarations but never acquire data or train models.
The 1 KiB batch setting is a fixture boundary, not a research recommendation.
Scientific KML plans and their specialized tests remain separate and unchanged.
